rationale: The long thesis required price to hold above the 5m 9-EMA and VWAP, but price has now slipped to $87.35, below the 9-EMA ($87.44), with the last five 1m candles rolling over lower (87.55→87.42, tape now 87.35). With SPY -0.33%/VIX +1.82% risk-off and price only $0.10 above the $87.25 invalidation, the continuation edge has decayed; exiting at a tiny loss is preferable to gambling on the stop, and a short is not justified while price still sits just above VWAP.
